system.name: npd-loader
system.description: Downloads the CMS National Provider Directory FHIR bulk release, loads it into SQL Server (or Postgres) as raw JSON plus 26 flattened tables, publishes each release atomically and records every run and file in the warehouse catalog

people.name: Data engineer / operator
people.description: Runs init-db, import --force, status and profile by hand; installs and schedules the loader

people.name: Analyst / downstream jobs
people.description: Query the published npd tables and v_* latest-release views

containers.name: npd-loader CLI
containers.technology: Python 3.12, Python-DataEngine (SQLAlchemy + pyodbc / psycopg2), httpx, zstandard
containers.description: Stages download -> extract -> import (raw load, T-SQL transforms, partition-SWITCH publish, retention); commands run, download, extract, import, status, init-db, profile

containers.name: npd database
containers.description: npd_raw.resource (raw FHIR JSON, varchar(max) UTF-8) and 26 npd.* tables, partitioned by release_date; npd.release; v_* views

containers.name: npd database (Postgres flavor)
containers.description: Alternative flavor selected by a type: postgres connection; same schema with JSONB raw layer and list partitions (ported to DataEngine, not yet verified against a server)

containers.name: Warehouse catalog
containers.description: Shared run and file tracking: dbo.MASTER_WAREHOUSE_RUN (one row per DOWNLOAD/EXTRACT/IMPORT run) and dbo.DATA_FILE (manifest, .zst, .ndjson files)

containers.name: Release file store
containers.technology: Local disk (storage backend 'local', e.g. D:\npd or E:\npd_dev_data)
containers.description: Run folders holding the manifest, downloaded .ndjson.zst files and extracted .ndjson files

external_systems.name: CMS National Provider Directory downloads
external_systems.description: Publishes the weekly FHIR bulk release: manifest.json plus one .ndjson.zst per resource type, served through signed redirect URLs

external_systems.name: Windows Task Scheduler
external_systems.description: Starts `npd-loader run` daily through scripts/npd-loader-run.cmd, which appends the log

relationships.description: Fetches manifest and release files from
Writes .zst and .ndjson files to, reads them back for import
Bulk-loads raw JSON, runs T-SQL transforms, publishes by partition SWITCH
Same stages via COPY and ATTACH PARTITION (Postgres flavor)
Records runs and data files in
Queries published release tables and v_* views

npd-loader.npd_loader.cli: Entry point: parses commands, builds the stage Context (dialect, catalog, storage, HTTP client), maps outcomes to exit codes
npd-loader.npd_loader.config: Parses config.toml into typed sections; rejects legacy host/user/password keys
npd-loader.npd_loader.connections: Reads the DataEngine database.env and builds SqlConnectionObject / PgConnectionObject by name
npd-loader.npd_loader.stages: Shared stage plumbing: Context, run lock hook, run folders, failure recording, closing interrupted runs
npd-loader.npd_loader.download: DOWNLOAD stage: manifest, signed-URL fetch with retries, sha256, data_file rows
npd-loader.npd_loader.manifest: Parses manifest.json and maps file names to FHIR resource types
npd-loader.npd_loader.extract: EXTRACT stage: .zst -> .ndjson, restores deleted files in place
npd-loader.npd_loader.import_stage: IMPORT stage: finds inputs, drops orphans, raw load -> transforms -> publish, marks files loaded
npd-loader.npd_loader.raw_load: Shared NDJSON line reader and validator (JSON object, resourceType, id, lastUpdated)
npd-loader.npd_loader.dialect: Engine-specific operations behind one protocol: init-db, raw load, transforms, publish, retention drops, run lock, orphan cleanup (mssql.py, postgres.py)
npd-loader.npd_loader.sqltext: SQL token rendering, GO batch splitting, standalone table names, packaged SQL scripts
npd-loader.npd_loader.retention: Keeps the newest keep_releases published releases; drops older partitions and their .ndjson files
npd-loader.npd_loader.catalog: SqlCatalog on SQLAlchemy Core over MASTER_WAREHOUSE_RUN / DATA_FILE (both engines)
npd-loader.npd_loader.runxml: Builds xml_config / xml_output for catalog runs
npd-loader.npd_loader.storage: LocalStorage: atomic writes, reads, sizes and deletes under the storage root
npd-loader.npd_loader.profile: `profile` command: lists JSON paths in a release file and flags unmapped ones

flows.name: Scheduled daily run (download, extract, import)
flows.description: From Task Scheduler to a published release; the import extracts first if .ndjson files are missing.

steps.description: GET manifest.json, then each .ndjson.zst via signed URL
Raw batches (5,000 rows, committed each), parse-once T-SQL transforms, SPLIT + SWITCH publish in one transaction
IMPORT run Success + per-table row counts; DATE_LOADED on .ndjson rows

flows.name: Atomic publish of a release (SQL Server)
flows.description: Standalone per-release tables become visible to readers in one metadata-only transaction.

steps.description: ALTER PARTITION FUNCTION ... SPLIT RANGE (release) for both schemas
ALTER TABLE <standalone> SWITCH TO <parent> PARTITION n for 27 tables; DROP the empties
MERGE npd.release; COMMIT (retry whole transaction on lock timeout 1222)
v_* views now show the new release
steps.note: assumption: consumers read via the views
